subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant-thread status show sanitized per-tool progress, or should tool detail remain limited to loading messages, preview progress, task cards, and opt-in status reactions?
rationale: Source inspection proves the wiring gap, but exposing active tool labels through Slack native status is a UX and disclosure policy choice that overlaps existing progress surfaces and the open Slack-safe visibility work.

options.title: Decide Policy First
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the Slack native-status disclosure/default policy before accepting another implementation.

options.title: Implement Sanitized Native Status
options.body: Allow a narrow Slack-owned implementation that reuses safe shared progress labels, dedupes repeated writes, clears reliably, and proves live Slack behavior.

options.title: Keep Native Status Generic
options.body: Narrow or close the request only if maintainers decide native Slack status should remain generic and progress detail belongs solely in existing progress surfaces.

recommendation.title: Decide Policy First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the Slack native-status disclosure/default policy before accepting another implementation.
